integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses no finite computation as a substitute for an infinite argument. The external inputs are the weak-unit individual ergodic theorem of Dobrick and the regular-sublattice invariance of uo-convergence of Gao--Troitsky--Xanthos.
scientific_limitations: Positivity is used to prove invariance of the orbit-generated ideal.
Power boundedness, mean ergodicity, and order continuity of the norm remain assumed.
The conclusion is uo-convergence in the original lattice, not order convergence there.
An equivalent older formulation under different positive-operator terminology cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Local orbit ideals remove the weak-unit hypothesis for positive mean ergodic operators
